name: Font Awesome Formatter for Int List
description: Field formatter for list_integer fields that renders the stored value as a fixed row of icons (value 'on' icons plus the remaining 'off' icons, total = number of allowed values), e.g. a 5-star rating. Ships no icon library; you supply the icon markup.
project_description: This is a field formatter for a select list with int values (core list_integer field). Its use is to make some kind of rating display available but without any processing! It just outputs an int select field as icons. You can use Font Awesome or any other icon service using the same schema (an <i> tag). The rating image can be ANY Font Awesome icon: apples, stars, circles, you name it. You can also use other icon libraries; the author uses a custom IcoMoon set to avoid loading multi-MB Font Awesome files. How to use: create a field list(int), add selectable values like 1 2 3 4 5 6, choose the 'FA Int Formatter' formatter in Manage display, and paste your icon HTML. The formatter renders a fixed row of icons per item: the stored value renders as 'on' icons and the remaining count (max allowed values minus value) as 'off' icons, styled by the module's CSS (yellow star-on, dark star-off). Originally built to display book ratings as stars in a Views listing; the field itself stays a plain integer select in the backend. Note the module ships only the display markup and its own small CSS, not the Font Awesome library itself.
